explication: ClassIsland is a cross-platform classroom-display application. Its main user-facing workflow is to configure a class profile and display preferences, show the current timetable and lesson information, and issue timed reminders. The README also documents profile import/export, customizable components, plugins and themes, automation, weather, authentication, time synchronization, and updating. The graph combines these documented capabilities with the sampled startup, settings, storage, platform, update, and management modules; several feature implementations are unsampled, so their internal connections are left unverified.
